SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(age85plus_tot AS double) AS aged_85_plus FROM govblock_census.popest_cc_est_agesex WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '7' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How did the number of utility patents granted change from 2000 to 2024?

SELECT substr(patent_date, 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS patents FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_patent WHERE patent_type = 'utility' AND substr(patent_date, 1, 4) IN ('2000', '2024') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which medical subject headings are used most often as a paper's major topic?
SELECT descriptor_name, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_health.pubmed_mesh WHERE major_topic = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How did total U.S. energy consumption change from 1960 to 2023?
SELECT period, try_cast(value AS double) AS billion_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id = 'SEDS.TETCB.US.A' AND period IN ('1960', '2023') ORDER BY 1
Which public universities charge out-of-state students the most in tuition and fees?
SELECT instnm, try_cast(tuitionfee_out AS double) AS out_of_state FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution WHERE cast(control AS varchar) = '1' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What was the highest statewide load NYISO forecast for any hour of 2024?
SELECT max(try_cast(nyiso AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_solar.nyiso_load_forecast_isolf WHERE substr(time_stamp, 7, 4) = '2024'
Which countries' patent documents are cited most often by U.S. patents?
SELECT citation_country, count(*) AS citations FROM govblock_patents.pv_g_foreign_citation WHERE citation_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What was the highest yield at any 10-year note auction in 2023?
SELECT max(try_cast(high_yield AS double)) AS highest FROM govblock_treasury.auctions_query WHERE security_term = '10-Year' AND security_type = 'Note' AND substr(auction_date, 1, 4) = '2023'
Which companies' shares did investment managers hold the most of by value at the end of 2024?

SELECT i.nameofissuer, round(sum(try_cast(i.value AS double))) AS reported_value FROM govblock_sec.sec_13f_infotable i JOIN govblock_sec.sec_13f_submission b ON b.accession_number = i.accession_number WHERE b.periodofreport = '31-DEC-2024' AND coalesce(i.putcall, '') = '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many appeals arose from judgments entered in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.originating_court_information WHERE substr(cast(date_judgment AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2024'
Which Medicaid managed care plans enrolled the most people in 2017?
Medicaid Managed Care Enrollment By Program And Plan

SELECT plan_name, state, try_cast(total_enrollment AS double) AS enrollees FROM govblock_health.medicaid_managed_care_enrollment_by_program_and_plan WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '2017' ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people lived in Texas according to the 2024 one-year survey?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0400000US48' AND variable = 'B01003_E001'
Which state house districts have the most voting-age citizens?
Eligible Voters by State House District
SELECT geoname, try_cast(cvap_est AS double) AS citizens_18_plus FROM govblock_elections.cvap_sldlc WHERE lntitle = 'Total' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many households in Manhattan rent their home?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36061' AND variable = 'B25003_E003'
Among districts with at least 10,000 students, which spent the most per pupil in fiscal 2017?

SELECT name, stabbr, round(try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) / try_cast(v33 AS double)) AS per_pupil FROM govblock_education.ccd_sdf WHERE cast(year AS varchar) = '17' AND try_cast(v33 AS double) >= 10000 AND try_cast(tcurelsc AS double) > 0 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 10
How many chemical reactions were extracted from U.S. patents granted in 2010?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_grants WHERE year = '2010'
Which completed trials enrolled the most people?
SELECT nct_id, brief_title, enrollment FROM govblock_health.ct_studies WHERE overall_status = 'COMPLETED' ORDER BY try_cast(enrollment AS integer) DESC LIMIT 10
How many people live in HUD-assisted homes in Brooklyn (Kings County)?
SELECT program_label, try_cast(people_total AS double) AS people FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_county WHERE code = '36047' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which kinds of outside identifiers does PubChem record most often?
SELECT c2, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_identifiers WHERE c2 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Are there more boys or girls in American public schools?

SELECT sex, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students, round(100.0 * sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) / sum(sum(try_cast(student_count AS double))) OVER (), 1) AS pct FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_052 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND total_indicator LIKE 'Category Set A%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which solar panel makers appear most often in installed systems?
SELECT module_manufacturer_1, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_energy.oedi_tracking_the_sun WHERE module_manufacturer_1 <> '-1' AND module_manufacturer_1 IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What power level did U.S. reactors report on average across 2023?
SELECT round(avg(try_cast(power AS double)), 1) AS avg_pct_power FROM govblock_reactors.nrc_power_status WHERE reportdt LIKE '%/2023 %'
Which counties had more deaths than births in 2023 by the widest margin?
SELECT ctyname, stname, try_cast(naturalchg2023 AS double) AS natural_change FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '50' ORDER BY 3 ASC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the exact mass of sucrose, in daltons?
SELECT try_cast(c2 AS double) AS exact_mass FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_mass WHERE c0 = '5988'
Which kinds of measure make up the national accounts series?
SELECT metricname, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_economy.bea_nipa_seriesregister WHERE metricname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people lived in Brooklyn and worked in Manhattan in 2019?

SELECT sum(s000) AS workers FROM govblock_labor.lodes_od WHERE state = 'ny' AND part = 'main' AND job_type = 'JT00' AND year = 2019 AND substr(h_geocode, 1, 5) = '36047' AND substr(w_geocode, 1, 5) = '36061'
Which industry sectors employed the most private-sector workers nationwide in 2023?
Jobs and Wages by County and Industry

SELECT t.industry_title, try_cast(q.annual_avg_emplvl AS double) AS jobs FROM govblock_labor.qcew_annual AS q JOIN govblock_labor.qcew_industry_titles AS t ON t.industry_code = q.industry_code WHERE q.area_fips = 'US000' AND q.agglvl_code = '14' AND q.own_code = '5' AND q.year = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
What is the date of the latest published patent application on file?
In which years did CRS publish the most reports held in the library?
SELECT substr(date, 1, 4), count(*) AS n FROM govblock_oversight.oversight_reports WHERE source = 'CRS' AND substr(date, 1, 4) IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is the total operating capacity of solar plants on the national map?
SELECT sum(try_cast(oper_cap AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' AND prim_fuel = 'SUN' AND try_cast(oper_cap AS double) > 0
Outside the United States, which countries host the most NIH-funded projects?
SELECT org_country, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE org_country <> 'UNITED STATES' AND org_country <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of adults in California are citizens?
SELECT round(100.0 * try_cast(cvap_est AS double) / try_cast(adu_est AS double), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_elections.cvap_state WHERE geoname = 'California' AND lntitle = 'Total'
Where is homeownership highest among the states?

SELECT g.name, round(100 * (max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25003_E002' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END)) / max(CASE WHEN a.variable = 'B25003_E001' THEN try_cast(a.value AS double) END), 1) AS pct_owner_occupied FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25003' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many bioactivity results does PubChem record for aspirin?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_bioactivities WHERE cid = 2244
Which states have the most courthouses on record?
SELECT state, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.courthouses WHERE state IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How long does a patent case last on average, from filing to closing?
SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', try_cast(date_filed AS date), try_cast(date_closed AS date)))) AS avg_days FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE date_closed IS NOT NULL
Which judges are assigned the most dockets in the Southern District of New York?
SELECT assigned_to_str, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.dockets WHERE court_id = 'nysd' AND assigned_to_str IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many sections does the current Code of Federal Regulations contain?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_regulations.ecfr_sections
Which states supplied the most coal to American power plants in 2020?
Eia923 Eia Schedules M Final Revision Page Fuel Receipts And Costs

SELECT coalmine_state, sum(try_cast(quantity AS double)) AS tons FROM govblock_energy.eia923_eia_schedules_m_final_revision_sheet_page_fuel_receipts_and_costs WHERE fuel_group = 'Coal' AND cast(year AS varchar) = '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much did candidates lend their own campaigns in the 2018 cycle?
SELECT sum(cand_loans) AS total FROM govblock_fec.candidate_summary WHERE cast(cycle AS varchar) = '2018'
Which companies have been named as defendants in the most patent lawsuits?
SELECT name, count(DISTINCT case_row_id) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_names WHERE party_type = 'Defendant' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judicial financial disclosure reports were filed for 2019?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.financial_disclosures WHERE year = '2019'
Which outside databases does Rhea cross-reference most often?
SELECT db, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2xrefs WHERE db IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
On average, what share of long-stay nursing home residents suffer a fall with major injury?

SELECT avg(try_cast(four_quarter_average_score AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_qualitymsr_mds WHERE resident_type = 'Long Stay' AND measure_description LIKE '%falls with major injury%'
In which grid areas was the most wholesale electricity delivered in 2023?

SELECT point_of_delivery_balancing_authority AS grid_area, round(sum(try_cast(standardized_quantity AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_energy.ferceqr_transactions WHERE year_quarter LIKE '2023%' AND product_name = 'ENERGY' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Democratic or Republican Senate candidates win more votes in 2018?

SELECT party_simplified, sum(try_cast(candidatevotes AS double)) AS votes FROM govblock_elections.medsl_senate_returns WHERE year = '2018' AND party_simplified IN ('DEMOCRAT', 'REPUBLICAN') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC
